name: Email Verification Code
subject: Verify Your Email - {{organizationName}}
body_html:
Verify Your Email

{{organizationName}}

Hello {{firstName}}!

You requested a new verification code for your email address. Use the code below to verify your email:

Your Verification Code: {{emailVerificationCode}}

This code expires in 15 minutes

How to verify your email:

  1. Verify Email

  2. Enter the verification code above

  3. Click "Verify Email"

Important: If you didn't request this verification code, please ignore this email. Your account security is not compromised.

If you have any questions, contact us at {{replyToEmail}}.

Best regards,
The {{organizationName}} Team

name: Password Reset Code
subject: Reset Your Password - {{organizationName}}
body_html:
Reset Your Password

{{organizationName}}

Hello {{firstName}}!

We received a request to reset your password for your {{organizationName}} account. Use the code below to create a new password:

Your Reset Code: {{passwordResetCode}}

This code expires in 15 minutes

How to reset your password:

  1. Reset Password

  2. Enter the reset code above

  3. Create a new strong password

  4. Click "Reset Password"

Security Alert: If you didn't request this password reset, please ignore this email and consider changing your password immediately. Your account may be at risk.

Password Requirements:

  • At least 8 characters long

  • One uppercase letter

  • One lowercase letter

  • One number

  • One special character

If you have any questions or concerns, contact us immediately at {{replyToEmail}}.

Stay secure,
The {{organizationName}} Security Team

name: Password Changed Confirmation
subject: Password Successfully Changed - {{organizationName}}
body_html:
Password Changed Successfully

{{organizationName}}

Hello {{firstName}}!

Your password has been successfully changed for your {{organizationName}} account.

Change Details

Time: {{changeTime}}

IP Address: {{ipAddress}}

Device: {{device}}

Security Confirmed: Your account is now protected with your new password. All existing sessions have been logged out for security.

Didn't change your password? If you didn't make this change, your account may be compromised. Please contact us immediately at {{replyToEmail}} and change your password again.

What happens next:

  • You'll need to log in again with your new password

  • All other devices will be automatically logged out

  • Your account security has been enhanced

Keep your account secure:

  • Use a unique password for this account

  • Don't share your password with anyone

  • Log out from shared devices

  • Enable two-factor authentication if available

If you have any questions or concerns, contact us at {{replyToEmail}}.

Stay secure,
The {{organizationName}} Security Team

name: Registration Welcome & Email Verification
subject: Welcome to {{organizationName}} - Verify Your Email
body_html:
Welcome to {{organizationName}}!

Hello {{firstName}}!

Thank you for joining {{organizationName}}.

To complete your registration, please verify your email address using the code below:

Your Verification Code: {{emailVerificationCode}}

(This code expires in 15 minutes)

How to verify your email:

  1. Verify Email

  2. Enter the verification code above

  3. Click "Verify Email"

Security Note: If you didn't create an account with us, please ignore this email. Your account will be automatically deleted if not verified within 24 hours.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at {{replyToEmail}}.

Best regards,
The {{organizationName}} Team
